Home.heroDescription: Get your projects done professionally with top freelancers

features.escrowDesc: Project funds are held in a secure wallet and released only after work is completed and approved.
features.kycDesc: Identity verification is mandatory for all users — verified identity means clear responsibility and mutual trust.
features.kuraimiDesc: Deposit easily via local Kuraimi Bank transfers — ideal for users in Yemen.
features.paypalDesc: For international clients — instant deposit and withdrawal via PayPal in USD.

steps.registerDesc: Create your account in a minute and choose your type: client or freelancer, then verify your identity.
steps.postDesc: Write a clear description of your project and set your budget and timeline.
steps.hireDesc: Compare proposals and choose the best freelancer with financial protection.
steps.payDesc: Track progress, receive final work and release payment when satisfied.
